# `assets/fx/` — hit-effect textures

Six small PNGs. `scripts/hit-fx.mjs` tints and composites them into the tracer, bolt, swing, impact
and blast beats Ghostwire draws on the canvas when a gun, spell, melee strike or grenade lands.

## Provenance

**Every file in this folder is generated by `tools/make-fx-assets.mjs`, which is part of this
repository.** No third-party art is vendored here. Nothing was copied, traced or re-encoded from
JB2A, Automated Animations, Sequencer, FXMaster or any other module on disk.

That is a deliberate call rather than an accident of convenience. The JB2A free pack
(`modules/JB2A_DnD5e/`) is the obvious source for a muzzle flash and it is licensed
**CC BY-NC-SA 4.0** — redistribution is allowed, but with attribution, a non-commercial restriction
and a share-alike obligation that would attach to anything Ghostwire built on top of it. That is a
large licence footprint to take on for a flash of light, so Ghostwire draws its own light instead.

To reproduce the files:

```
node tools/make-fx-assets.mjs
```

The generator is deterministic — same bytes every run — so the committed PNGs can always be checked
against it.

## Format

8-bit **greyscale + alpha** PNG (colour type 4), grey channel flat `255`. A browser decodes that to
pure white pixels with a shaped alpha, so one texture serves every colour: `hit-fx.mjs` sets
`sprite.tint` per profile (and per spell flavour) and draws additively. The largest file is 256 px
on its long edge; the whole folder is under 16 KB.

| File | Size | What it is | Used by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `glow.png` | 128×128 | Hot core inside a wide halo | muzzle, tracer head, bolt head, impact flash |
| `flare.png` | 128×128 | Glow plus four spikes and two diagonals | impact centre, grenade detonation |
| `ring.png` | 128×128 | Soft annulus | the expanding shockwave on every impact |
| `beam.png` | 256×32 | Bright centre line, soft shoulders, tapered ends | the tracer / bolt stretched origin→target |
| `spark.png` | 64×16 | Tapered streak, bright at the leading end | the shards a bullet impact throws |
| `slash.png` | 128×128 | Crescent band, fat at the middle, thin at the tips | the melee swing |

The tapers on `beam.png` and the falloff on `glow.png`/`flare.png` reach exactly zero at the texture
edge, so a stretched or scaled sprite never shows the seam where the bitmap stops.

## If a texture is missing

`scripts/fx-canvas.mjs` caches these on `ready` and on every `canvasReady`. A hit fired before the
cache is warm — or on a table where one of these files failed to load — falls through to the
shimmed vector beats in `hit-fx.mjs`, which need no assets at all. The effect is plainer; it is
never blank, and it never throws.
